no_lastfm

join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!lastfm
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set lastfm foobar
send hortbot #foobar [HB] LastFM user changed to foobar.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!lastfm
send hortbot #foobar [HB] https://www.last.fm/user/foobar

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add np Now playing: (_SONG_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'np' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add lastsong Previously playing: (_LAST_SONG_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'lastsong' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add sl Song link: (_SONG_URL_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'sl' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!np
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Now playing: (Unknown)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!lastsong
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Previously playing: (Unknown)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!songlink
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!sl
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Song link: (Unknown)
